summary: Report Fractal product names and builds in the connected-clients view

replay.detail: Client presence labels do not change stored events or replay inputs.

schema.detail: The existing optional x-st3-client header and client option are unchanged.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or coordinated member upgrade changes.

compatibility.detail: The CLI reports fractal instead of st. Updated first-party client entrypoints supply their product name and existing version or build, while internal Rust transports and two Swift stream helpers can still omit the header. Product-specific telemetry classes retain the existing closed vocabulary and legacy spellings remain accepted. The daemon continues to display the name supplied by each client; older and unnamed clients remain supported.

downtime.detail: No daemon interruption or migration is required.

manual.detail: Operators see Fractal product names in connected clients after updating and reconnecting the corresponding clients. No configuration changes are needed.

recovery.detail: No persistent state changes or new rollback restrictions.
